title: A variational characterization of the collapse boundary in finite-resource clearance networks: analysis code
description: Derivation, verification and numerical study of the collapse boundary of a finite-resource proteostasis clearance network. Accompanies the manuscript of the same name. Every reported number is recomputable from the tracked scripts; see DECISIONS.md for the decision log and notes/POSTDICTION_PROTOCOL.md for the empirical-contact protocol.
